hypothesis: For the non-affine family rho(epsilon) proportional to exp[-beta(H+epsilon V)], a localized finite-chain perturbation has nonzero first-order modular susceptibility while relative entropy converges quadratically; energy follows by KMS identity. The order is family-specific.

config.response_family: non-affine finite KMS family of H + epsilon V
config.isospectral_control: exp(-i theta X_center) rho exp(i theta X_center)
config.local_energy_convention: split each pair term equally between endpoints

checks.name: nonaffine_kms_response_orders
checks.criterion: relative coefficient drift <= 1e-3, |log-log slope-2| <= 0.02, normalized RMSE <= 1e-2, minimum signal/floor >= 1000; signed Richardson susceptibility exceeds ten total errors and agrees with the exact Kubo-Mori value; family is detectably non-affine

checks.name: quadratic_gate_rejects_first_order_negative_control
checks.criterion: the same quadratic-order gate rejects c1*epsilon+c2*epsilon^2

checks.name: localized_energy_is_conserved_and_spreads
checks.criterion: conservation drift below 1e-12, initial endpoint fraction below 1e-12, and t=1 endpoint fraction above 0.05

checks.name: nonaffine_kms_parameter_sensitivity
checks.criterion: direct quadratic and Richardson gates pass, numerical coefficients agree with Kubo-Mori values, and every response clears its precision floor over the declared beta<=3 finite sweep

checks.name: isospectral_unitary_identity_regression
checks.criterion: D and Delta<K> agree within the dimension-scaled roundoff bound and DeltaS=0; fitted slopes are descriptive only

checks.name: spreading_requires_noncommuting_dynamics
checks.criterion: commuting Ising control profile change below 1e-12

checks.name: pipeline_reduced_modular_blindness_and_density_repair
checks.criterion: reduced-state source norm below 1e-12, KMS energy-density source norm above 1e-3, and density implementation error below 1e-14

checks.name: negative_energy_candidate_has_slower_source_clock
checks.criterion: center Phi below edge Phi, clock-rate ratio below 1, redshift positive
